name: Dunelm Group plc
summary: Dunelm Group plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the retail of homewares in the United Kingdom and Ireland. The company offers furniture and beds products, such as bedroom, living room, dining room, and other furniture, as well as sofas and armchairs; and bedding products comprising bed linen, duvets, pillows, protectors, dorma, and baby and kids bedding products. It also provides home decors, including wall art and decor, flowers and plants, ornaments, vases, mirrors, photo and picture frames, decorative trays and bowls, candles and home fragrance, clocks, fireplace accessories, curtains, rugs, cushions, throws, bean bags, housewarming gifts, engagement and wedding gifts, annive…
